birth.segment: Manlius to Syracuse: The Researcher Before the Artist
birth.stop: Manlius, the birth the record gives twice
birth.date_confidence: The year 1951 is institutional (MoMA and Pierogi biographical materials, which give the year and the city of Syracuse only). The exact day, 23 March, and the village of Manlius come from obituary-derived secondary sources (Wikipedia, after Roberta Smith, New York Times, 25 March 2000). stops.stop: Williamsburg, the apartment
stops.date_confidence: Attested. MoMA's archival finding aid, the record of the institution that holds his papers, states that the death was suicide by hanging; corroborated by Roberta Smith's obituary, New York Times, 25 March 2000, and Adrian Dannatt's, The Independent, 16 May 2000. The murder rumours amplified by Patricia Goldstone's Interlock (2015) are recorded as rumour: no located evidence overturns the institutional finding. No street address appears in any reachable source, so the pin is the neighbourhood.
